biggest_catch: You must reach Advantage Plus Rewards status within 90 days of opening the account - not just open it. Also: new members only (never had an Advia membership), employees excluded, and the $250 lands in Share Savings (not the checking account) within 45 days of month-end reporting.
catches: Open a new Advia Credit Union member account with New Member Code NM1000 (or gain membership through an indirect loan at an auto/RV dealership).
Qualify for Advantage Plus Rewards status within 90 days of the account origination date; qualification is based on monthly account activity and is determined on a 35-day lookback basis.
$250 incentive is deposited into your Share Savings within 45 days following month-end reporting showing qualifications have been met.
Not valid for current or previous Advia members, or for Advia Credit Union employees.

Full account relationship must be in good standing at time of payout; if the account is closed within 6 months of incentive payout, funds equal to the incentive may be withheld before account closing.
This offer may not be combined with other promotional offers; incentives are reported to the IRS.
Offer and rates subject to change at any time.

steps: Open a new Advia Credit Union member account with New Member Code NM1000.
Open a qualifying checking relationship (Regular, Assurance, or Money Market checking).
Reach Advantage Plus Rewards status through monthly account activity within 90 days of the account origination date.
Keep the account relationship in good standing; the $250 incentive is deposited into your Share Savings within 45 days following month-end reporting that shows qualifications were met.
timing: Qualify within 90 days of account origination; incentive paid within 45 days following month-end reporting showing qualifications were met. No fixed end date - offer may change at any time.
